general.title: General
general.desc: Appearance, language, popup, shortcuts, sync, and backup

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHint: Auto: dark from 18:00 to 6:00. Applies to the popup, settings, side panel, and new tab
appearance.languageHint: Applies to the popup, settings, side panel, new tab, and the selection toolbar on pages. The extension name and shortcut descriptions follow the browser's own language

popup.title: Popup
popup.defaultTabHint: The page the popup opens on when you click the toolbar icon or press its shortcut

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.descFirefox: Browsers don't let extensions change their own shortcuts. Customize them in about:addons via the gear icon at the top right → "Manage Extension Shortcuts".
shortcuts.desc: Browsers don't let extensions change their own shortcuts; set them on the extension shortcuts page. This page refreshes automatically once you change them.

sync.title: Sync across devices
sync.desc: Quick links and proxy configuration sync to your other devices with the browser account.

backup.title: Backup
backup.desc: Export / import all configuration (quick links, network, translation, AI models, etc.). API keys are never written to backup files.

translate.title: Translation
translate.desc: Side-by-side page translation, hover translation, and always-translated sites

page.title: Page translation
page.desc: Full-page side-by-side translation: translations follow each original paragraph and load as you scroll.
page.modelMissing: No translation model configured yet; AI translation is unavailable for now
page.freeHint: Google and Microsoft are free to use. To translate with an LLM, configure your own model
page.targetHint: Auto: Chinese pages are translated to English; other pages to Simplified Chinese
page.displayModeHint: Translation only: hide the original text and keep just the translation
page.underlineHint: Mark translations with a dotted underline to tell them apart from the original

autoHosts.title: Always translate these sites
autoHosts.desc: Translate these sites fully when opened. You can also toggle the current site in the popup.

models.title: AI models
models.desc: Works with any OpenAI-compatible API (including Coding Plans). Translation and chat are configured separately: fast for translation, strong for chat.

translateModel.title: Translation model
translateModel.desc: Used for full-page / hover / selection translation when the engine is set to "AI model". Pick a fast model without deep thinking, e.g. glm-4-flash, qwen-turbo, deepseek-chat.

chatModel.title: Chat model
chatModel.desc: Used for selection explain / summarize / polish and the side panel AI assistant. Pick a strong model with tool calling, e.g. GLM-4.6, Kimi K2, qwen3-max, or a Coding Plan.
chatModel.resetHint: If you'd rather not maintain a separate config, switch back to following the translation model

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.desc: The AI assistant in the browser side panel, using the chat model from "AI models"

sidepanel.title: Side panel assistant
sidepanel.desc: Summarize pages, extract key points, and ask about page content (including Shadow DOM pages). "Ask AI" in the selection toolbar opens here with the selection.
sidepanel.shortcutHint: Shortcut {shortcut}; can also open from the popup's Features page
sidepanel.noShortcutHint: No shortcut set. Set one under General → Shortcuts

webmcp.title: Page tools (WebMCP)
webmcp.desc: Pages can expose runnable tools to the AI via WebMCP (queries, orders, form filling, etc.); the assistant discovers and calls them automatically. Needs Chrome 150 or later, with "WebMCP for testing" enabled in chrome://flags.
webmcp.confirmHint: Page tools not declared read-only (they may modify data) ask for your confirmation before running

enhance.title: Page enhancements
enhance.desc: Floating dock, GitHub enhancements, and per-site copy unlocking

dock.title: Floating dock
dock.desc: The DevGo bubble on the right edge of pages: hover to expand quick actions like translating the page, AI summary, and AI assistant. Drag it up or down to reposition.
dock.label: Show the floating dock
dock.hint: You can also hide it for now or on the current site from the bubble's close menu
dock.disabledHosts: Sites where the dock is hidden

github.label: GitHub enhancements
github.hint: Floating buttons on code pages (edit online, DeepWiki, back to top); press , to open github1s

unlock.title: Sites with copy unlocked
unlock.desc: Unlock copy, selection, and right-click on these sites. Applies only to listed sites (unlocking everywhere breaks online editors and the like); you can also toggle the current site in the popup's Features page.

selection.title: Selection
selection.desc: The toolbar that appears when you select text on a page

toolbar.title: Selection toolbar
toolbar.enableHint: Show the toolbar next to selected text on pages; single English words also show dictionary definitions
toolbar.aiHint: Needs a working chat model (follows the translation model if not set separately). When off, only translation remains

disabledHosts.title: Sites where selection is off
disabledHosts.desc: Don't show the selection toolbar on these sites. Toggle the current site from the popup's Features page.

actions.title: Toolbar actions
actions.desc: The toolbar shows up to {count} actions directly and folds the rest into "More". Built-in actions come first, custom actions follow in the order below. On page text there's also "Ask AI", which opens the side panel with the selection.
actions.aiUnavailable: AI actions are off or no chat model is configured, so the toolbar shows only "Translate".
actions.empty: No custom actions yet. Add a name and a prompt, and the toolbar can run AI on your selection exactly the way you want.
actions.deleteDesc: The action disappears from the toolbar and its prompt is deleted too.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.namePlaceholder: Shown on the toolbar, e.g. "Translate to English"
dialog.scopeHint: When text is selected in an input, the result can replace it in one click; the model then outputs only the processed text.
dialog.promptPlaceholder: Tell the AI how to handle the selection, e.g.: translate the selection into natural English and output only the translation.
dialog.promptHint: Like built-in actions, the surrounding paragraph and page title are attached automatically — no need to include them in the prompt.
